cc:Work.dc:description: PARTIAL REPLAY: the expansion panel uses every released expansion row and the audit's optimizer/property energy and excess-pressure conventions. It uses the measured V(T) path, not an isotherm. The inconsistent standalone calculators are excluded. Shock rows cannot yet be replayed as the identical fitted residual vector without the unsaved iterative shock-temperature state; they are omitted, not reconstructed as observations. The displayed RMS is for this expansion subset only, not the full robust-bisquare fit.
